title: University Examination Branch: Clarification on Fake Examination Postponement Circulars
content: It has come to the notice of the University Examination Branch that a fake circular claiming all semester examinations scheduled for next week have been postponed is circulating on WhatsApp and social media groups. Students are advised to note that no examinations have been postponed. All undergraduate and postgraduate examinations will be conducted strictly as per the notified date-sheet. Students should rely solely on the official university portal for announcements.
